identify: The photo model matched this to the rice gall midge.
The silver shoot is a sign of gall midge damage.
The gall midge is a major rice pest in India.

thresholds.etl: Early to late tillering: 1 gall/m2 or 10% Silver shoot.

cultural: Drain the rice field for 5-7 days.
Control grassy weeds and wild rice around the field.

Plough under the ratoon of the previous crop.
